points.description: Gives one valid factor influencing chatter (e.g., depth of cut, width of cut, or hardness of workpiece), in any wording.
Gives a second, different valid factor influencing chatter (e.g., depth of cut, width of cut, or hardness of workpiece), in any wording.

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each distinct valid factor, up to 2 marks. Accept the model answer factors (depth of cut, width of cut, hardness of workpiece) in any wording; other plausible machining factors such as cutting speed or feed may be accepted generously. Give 0 for a factor that is wrong or unrelated; a wrong extra item does not lose marks.
